Lava fountains erupted from the summit of Hawaii’s Kilauea volcano in the early hours of Monday, Nov. 23, according to live footage from the United States Geological Survey (USGS).

The geological agency said the eruption sent a plume of volcanic material up to 16,500 feet (5,000 meters) above sea level.

Courtesy: USGS via Reuters
